# PenniLogic/ai-service

Backend AI routing and explanations; no client raw-message ingestion.

**Current scope:** Repository foundation plus the health-only AI service scaffold from PenniLogic/ai-service#1; no provider traffic, key handling or inference is implemented.

Read this file, the linked plan item, relevant product decisions and
`.github/agent-policy.json`. This new public repository has its own delivery
baseline; private-era setup holds remain recorded in PenniLogic-old, not copied
as assertions that unfinished product work is accepted here.

## Delivery

Use an issue-sized branch and a pull request. Continue an existing task rather
than opening a duplicate. After the initial reviewed import, do not push to
protected main, bypass a failing check, or rewrite reviewed history.
Perform two self-reviews: correctness/diff hygiene, then security/privacy/money
and edge cases. Get a separate non-author Core review; behavior changes also
need QA, and actual affected risks need the matching specialist. A required
negative review blocks integration. Record reviewer session, reviewed commit,
findings and evidence in the PR; one GitHub account cannot provide two-human
approval. No custom CheckRun publisher or self-reported identity is proof of
independence.

GitHub requires the real native `CI` job, PR-only integration, resolved threads
and current base. Its approving-review count is zero because the sole account
cannot approve its own PR. Never invent another GitHub reviewer.

## Commands

```text
python scripts/setup.py
python scripts/check_repository.py
printf 'uv==0.11.33 --hash=sha256:9542178978b0b6f16a7ae99e55aca039f493a1edb373a15d7993eab80a28615a\n' | python -m pip install --quiet --only-binary :all: --require-hashes --no-deps -r /dev/stdin
uv sync --locked
uv run --locked ruff check .
uv run --locked ruff format --check .
uv run --locked mypy
uv run --locked pytest
```

Repository-specific setup, commands and troubleshooting are maintained by hand in
[docs/development.md](docs/development.md); that guide is not generated.

Install the managed hook with the documented setup command. Preserve a custom
hook rather than replacing it. Never claim an unrun build, test, accessibility
or load gate passed; foundation checks are not product acceptance.

## Safety

- Never commit credentials, production data, raw SMS/email or user financial records.
- Keep money in integer minor units plus currency; calculations are deterministic and server-authoritative.
- Keep ledger history append-only, sharing default-deny and entitlements enforced by the server.
- The app must remain usable when optional permissions are denied.
- Preserve other agents' files, branches and findings; one active writer per checkout.
- Use additive contracts and serialize database migrations and protected merges.
- No paid runner, provider, storage allowance increase or production deployment without explicit approval.

## Shared setup

`PenniLogic/infra/governance` owns generated setup. Edit that source and regenerate;
do not maintain divergent generated files. Shared agent profiles live in
`PenniLogic/.github/agents`. `.github/github-app.yml` provides manual scripts;
its presence does not imply app trust or automatic execution.
